{{Top|leg}}
'''"Mysterious Disaster Strikes Caamas"''' was the headline of a news story concerning the [[Caamas Firestorm|Destruction of Caamas]]. It contained speculation that the majority of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas's]] inhabitants had [[Death/Legends|died]] in firestorms that had been caused by a wayward "cluster of high-yield [[actinium bomb]]s, no doubt of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] origin".
